```{r}
here::i_am("Charm-Prices.Rproj")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```


#first read the data
```{r}
stations_raw <- map_dfr(2021:2023, function(y) {
  read_csv(here("data", paste0("stations_", y, ".csv")),
           col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
    mutate(year = y)
})
```

#cleaning the data
```{r}
stations <- stations_raw %>%
  mutate(latitude  = as.numeric(latitude) / 100000,     # 4620114 -> 46.20114
         longitude = as.numeric(longitude) / 100000,
         latitude  = na_if(latitude, 0),                # 0 = no coordinates
         longitude = na_if(longitude, 0),
         cp        = str_pad(cp, 5, pad = "0"),         # 1000 -> "01000"
         motorway  = pop == "A") %>%                    # A = motorway, R = road
  arrange(id, desc(year)) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%                    # one row per station (latest year)
  select(id, latitude, longitude, cp, motorway, last_year = year)
```

#checking part 
```{r}
nrow(stations)                    # number of stations
sum(is.na(stations$latitude))     # stations without coordinates
summary(stations$latitude)        # France: 41 to 51 (overseas: down to about -21)
summary(stations$longitude)
count(stations, motorway)
```
```{r}
write_csv(stations, here("data", "clean", "stations.csv"))
```
